notes:
K8Secret 0.6.19 — colour you can actually read, on every theme.

Status colours were chosen by eye and it showed. Measured properly — as contrast against every one of the five cluster colours, in light and dark — they sat well below the threshold for readable text in light mode, and worst of all where a status shared its cluster's colour: a crash-looping container announced itself on the amber cluster in a pale olive that was, in practice, invisible.

Every status and metric colour has been rechosen against that measurement, and the app's tests now check it, so this cannot quietly drift again.

The sidebar also cut its last item, Events, in half against the port-forwards footer with no way to scroll it into view. Fixed.
